words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 病人 like the word you’ll use for the person seeing the doctor — 课文（一）的病人.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers call a patient 病人 in clinic talk. Here the dialogue speaker is labeled 病人.

example.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le?
example.en: What’s wrong with you?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 肚子 like the belly that hurts — 肚子疼得厉害.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 肚子疼 / 肚子痛 for stomach pain. Clinic 课文 opens with this.

example.zh: 肚子疼得厉害，在家吃了两片药，还不行。
example.pinyin: Dùzi téng de lìhai, zài jiā chī le liǎng piàn yào, hái bù xíng.
example.en: My stomach hurts badly — I took two tablets at home and it still didn’t help.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 厉害 like ‘badly / severe’ after 得 — 疼得厉害.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use Adj/V + 得厉害 for high intensity. Here the pain is severe.

example.pinyin: Dùzi téng de lìhai.
example.en: My stomach hurts badly.

words.en: an aspect particle used after a verb or an adjective to indicate the completion of a real or expected action or change
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added. Verb/adjective + 了 (completion) — this lesson’s grammar focus; different sense from Lesson 1 sentence-final 了.
words.when: Remember this 了 like the aspect marker after a verb — 吃了, 拉了, 哭了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers put 了 after the verb for completed action. Object usually needs a measure or other attribute (见语法).

example.zh: 在家吃了两片药，还不行。
example.pinyin: Zài jiā chī le liǎng piàn yào, hái bù xíng.
example.en: I took two tablets at home and it still didn’t help.

words.en: (a measure word for slices, tablets, etc.) piece
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 片 like the tablet measure — 两片药.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers count pills and slices with 片. Pattern: 一次两片.

example.zh: 一天三次，一次两片，饭后吃。
example.pinyin: Yì tiān sān cì, yí cì liǎng piàn, fàn hòu chī.
example.en: Three times a day, two tablets each time, after meals.

words.en: to suffer from diarrhoea; to have loose bowels
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book; part of speech not printed. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added. Book prints spaced lā dùzi.
words.when: Remember 拉肚子 like the clinic question — 拉肚子了吗？
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 拉肚子 for diarrhea. Related 拉 is under this entry.

example.pinyin: Lā dùzi le ma?
example.en: Do you have diarrhea?

words.note: Listed under the numbered shengci entry in the book (related form). Headword pinyin printed. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 拉 like the verb half of 拉肚子 — 拉了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 拉 for having a bowel movement in this medical sense.

example.pinyin: Lā le.
example.en: Yes, I did.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 鱼 like the food the patient ate — 一些鱼.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean fish as food here. Paired with 牛肉 in the diet history.

example.pinyin: Jiù chī le yìxiē yú hé niúròu.
example.en: I only ate some fish and beef.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 牛肉 like the other food in 就吃了一些鱼和牛肉.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean beef meat. Clinic history pairs it with 鱼.

example.pinyin: Jiù chī le yìxiē yú hé niúròu.
example.en: I only ate some fish and beef.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 化验 like the lab test — 去化验一下儿大便.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 化验 samples at the hospital. Results: 化验结果出来了.

example.zh: 你先去化验一下儿大便，然后我再给你检查检查。
example.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù huàyàn yíxiàr dàbiàn, ránhòu wǒ zài gěi nǐ jiǎncha jiǎncha.
example.en: First go have a stool test, then I’ll examine you.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 大便 like the stool sample for 化验.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 大便 in clinical talk. Related 小便 is listed under this entry.

example.zh: 你先去化验一下儿大便。
example.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù huàyàn yíxiàr dàbiàn.
example.en: First go have a stool test.

words.note: Listed under the numbered shengci entry in the book (related form). Headword pinyin printed. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 小便 like the urine counterpart of 大便.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 小便 in clinical talk. Listed under 大便 in the book.

example.pinyin: Huàyàn yíxiàr dàbiàn.
example.en: Have a stool test.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 检查 like the doctor’s exam after the lab — 给你检查检查.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 检查身体 / 检查一下. Reduplication softens the ask.

example.zh: 然后我再给你检查检查。
example.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ zài gěi nǐ jiǎncha jiǎncha.
example.en: Then I’ll examine you.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 结果 like the lab outcome — 化验结果出来了吗？
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean outcome/result. Here: test results.

example.pinyin: Huàyàn jiéguǒ chūlai le ma?
example.en: Are the lab results out?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 出来 like results appearing — 出来了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 出来 for something coming out or becoming available. Lab results 出来了.

example.pinyin: Chūlai le.
example.en: They’re out.

words.en: to be attacked (by a disease); to contract (a disease)
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 得 like catching an illness — 得了肠炎.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 得病 / 得了 + illness name. Not the structural 得 here.

example.zh: 大夫，我是不是得了肠炎？
example.pinyin: Dàifu, wǒ shì bu shì dé le chángyán?
example.en: Doctor, have I got enteritis?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 肠炎 like the illness the patient fears.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean intestinal inflammation. Doctor says it is not 肠炎.

example.zh: 不是肠炎，只是消化不好。
example.pinyin: Bú shì chángyán, zhǐ shì xiāohuà bù hǎo.
example.en: It’s not enteritis — just poor digestion.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 消化 like digestion — 消化不好.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 消化不好 for indigestion. Doctor’s diagnosis here.

example.zh: 不是肠炎，只是消化不好。
example.pinyin: Bú shì chángyán, zhǐ shì xiāohuà bù hǎo.
example.en: It’s not enteritis — just poor digestion.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 开（药） like the doctor writing a prescription — 开一些药.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 开药 for prescribing. Pattern: 给你开一些药.

example.zh: 先给你开一些药，再给你打一针。
example.pinyin: Xiān gěi nǐ kāi yìxiē yào, zài gěi nǐ dǎ yì zhēn.
example.en: I’ll prescribe some medicine first, then give you a shot.

words.en: to give or have an injection
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 打针 like getting a shot — 打一针.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 打针 / 打一针 at the clinic. After the prescription here.

example.pinyin: Zài gěi nǐ dǎ yì zhēn.
example.en: Then give you a shot.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 后 like after meals — 饭后吃.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 饭后 / …后 for ‘after.’ Medicine instructions: 饭后吃.

example.zh: 一天三次，一次两片，饭后吃。
example.pinyin: Yì tiān sān cì, yí cì liǎng piàn, fàn hòu chī.
example.en: Three times a day, two tablets each time, after meals.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 哭 like Mary’s tears — 你怎么哭了？
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 哭了 for crying. Lesson title: 玛丽哭了.

example.zh: 玛丽，你怎么哭了？病了吗？
example.pinyin: Mǎlì, nǐ zěnme kū le? Bìng le ma?
example.en: Mary, why are you crying? Are you sick?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 寂寞 like the lonely feeling that makes Mary homesick.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 感到寂寞 for loneliness. Cause in 因为…所以….

example.zh: 因为感到寂寞，所以心情不好，很难过。
example.pinyin: Yīnwèi gǎndào jìmò, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bù hǎo, hěn nánguò.
example.en: Because I feel lonely, I’m in a bad mood and very sad.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 所以 like the result half of 因为……所以…….
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers link cause→result with 所以. Grammar focus this lesson.

example.zh: 因为感到寂寞，所以心情不好。
example.pinyin: Yīnwèi gǎndào jìmò, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bù hǎo.
example.en: Because I feel lonely, I’m in a bad mood.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 别 like soft don’t — 别难过了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 别 + verb to stop or discourage an action. 注释: 别……了 for comfort.

example.pinyin: Bié nánguò le.
example.en: Don’t feel so bad.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 难过 like Mary’s sad mood — 很难过, 别难过了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 难过 for feeling upset. Roland comforts: 别难过了.

example.pinyin: Bié nánguò le.
example.en: Don’t feel so bad.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 礼堂 like the hall with the dance — 礼堂有舞会.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean a school/community auditorium. Tonight’s 舞会 is there.

example.zh: 今天晚上礼堂有舞会，我们一起去跳跳舞吧。
example.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang lǐtáng yǒu wǔhuì, wǒmen yìqǐ qù tiàotiaowǔ ba.
example.en: There’s a dance in the auditorium tonight — let’s go dance a bit.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 舞会 like the evening event Roland suggests.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean a dance party. Paired with 礼堂 and 跳舞.

example.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang lǐtáng yǒu wǔhuì.
example.en: There’s a dance in the auditorium tonight.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 跳舞 like going to dance — 跳跳舞 (reduplicated, see 注释).
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 跳舞 / 跳跳舞. Separable verb; overlap form softens the invite.

example.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù tiàotiaowǔ ba.
example.en: Let’s go dance a bit together.

lines.speaker: 病人
lines.zh: 肚子疼得厉害，在家吃了两片药，还不行。
lines.pinyin: Dùzi téng de lìhai, zài jiā chī le liǎng piàn yào, hái bù xíng.
lines.en: My stomach hurts badly — I took two tablets at home and it still didn’t help.

lines.speaker: 病人
lines.pinyin: Jiù chī le yìxiē yú hé niúròu.
lines.en: I only ate some fish and beef.

lines.speaker: 病人
lines.en: I drank a bottle of beer.

lines.speaker: 大夫
lines.zh: 你先去化验一下儿大便，然后我再给你检查检查。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù huàyàn yíxiàr dàbiàn, ránhòu wǒ zài gěi nǐ jiǎncha jiǎncha.
lines.en: First go have a stool test, then I’ll examine you.

lines.speaker: 病人
lines.zh: 大夫，我是不是得了肠炎？
lines.pinyin: Dàifu, wǒ shì bu shì dé le chángyán?

lines.speaker: 大夫
lines.zh: 我看了化验结果。不是肠炎，只是消化不好。先给你开一些药，再给你打一针。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le huàyàn jiéguǒ. Bú shì chángyán, zhǐ shì xiāohuà bù hǎo. Xiān gěi nǐ kāi yìxiē yào, zài gěi nǐ dǎ yì zhēn.
lines.en: I’ve looked at the results. It’s not enteritis — just poor digestion. I’ll prescribe some medicine first, then give you a shot.

lines.speaker: 病人
lines.en: How do I take this medicine?

lines.speaker: 护士
lines.zh: 一天三次，一次两片，饭后吃。
lines.pinyin: Yì tiān sān cì, yí cì liǎng piàn, fàn hòu chī.
lines.en: Three times a day, two tablets each time, after meals.

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 玛丽，你怎么哭了？病了吗？
lines.pinyin: Mǎlì, nǐ zěnme kū le? Bìng le ma?
lines.en: Mary, why are you crying? Are you sick?

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 不是。想家了。因为感到寂寞，所以心情不好，很难过。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Xiǎng jiā le. Yīnwèi gǎndào jìmò, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bù hǎo, hěn nánguò.
lines.en: No. I’m homesick. Because I feel lonely, I’m in a bad mood and very sad.

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 我也常想家，但是不感到寂寞。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě cháng xiǎng jiā, dànshì bù gǎndào jìmò.
lines.en: I miss home often too, but I don’t feel lonely.

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 我有姐姐，还有弟弟。在家时，我们常常一起玩儿，所以感到寂寞时总想他们。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jiějie, hái yǒu dìdi. Zài jiā shí, wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ wánr, suǒyǐ gǎndào jìmò shí zǒng xiǎng tāmen.
lines.en: I have an older sister and a younger brother. At home we often play together, so when I feel lonely I always think of them.

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 今天晚上礼堂有舞会，我们一起去跳跳舞吧。玩儿玩儿就好了。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang lǐtáng yǒu wǔhuì, wǒmen yìqǐ qù tiàotiaowǔ ba. Wánrwanr jiù hǎo le.
lines.en: There’s a dance in the auditorium tonight — let’s go dance a bit. Playing around a little will help.

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 吃了晚饭就去吧。你在宿舍等我，我来叫你。
lines.pinyin: Chī le wǎnfàn jiù qù ba. Nǐ zài sùshè děng wǒ, wǒ lái jiào nǐ.
lines.en: Let’s go after dinner. Wait for me in the dorm — I’ll come get you.

notes.title: 你怎么了？
notes.body: 询问已发生的情况及其过程、原因、理由时用“怎么了”。“怎么了” is used to inquire about a situation that has happened and its process, cause and reason. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le?
example.en: What’s wrong with you?

notes.title: 就吃了一些鱼和牛肉。
notes.body: “就”用在动宾词组前，表示动作涉及的范围小、数量少，有“仅仅，只”的意思。“就” is used before a verb-object phrase to indicate that the scope or quantity that the action involves is limited, suggesting “only/merely.” Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Jiù chī le yìxiē yú hé niúròu.
example.en: I only ate some fish and beef.

notes.title: 别难过了。
notes.body: “别……了”用于口语，表示安慰或劝告。“别……了” is used in spoken Chinese to console or persuade someone. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Bié nánguò le.
example.en: Don’t feel so bad.

notes.title: 跳跳舞
notes.body: “跳跳舞”是离合动词“跳舞”的重叠形式。“跳跳舞” is the reduplicated form of the separable verb “跳舞”. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù tiàotiaowǔ ba.
example.en: Let’s go dance a bit together.

notes.title: 动作的完成：动词＋了
notes.body: 动词后边加上动态助词“了”可以表示动作完成。“动词＋了”要带宾语时，宾语前要有数量词或其他词语作定语；若无，句末常需语气助词“了”，或用“V了O就V…”表示意念中的完成。正反问：……了没有？／动词＋没＋动词。否定：没（有）＋动词（后不再用“了”）。连动句中第一动词后不能有“了”。Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Wǒ chī le yìxiē yú hé niúròu.
example.en: I ate some fish and beef.

notes.title: 因为……所以……
notes.body: “因为……所以……”连接一个因果复句，表达事情的原因和结果。“因为”和“所以”也都可以单独使用。Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 因为感到寂寞，所以心情不好。
example.pinyin: Yīnwèi gǎndào jìmò, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bù hǎo.
example.en: Because I feel lonely, I’m in a bad mood.
